Metadata.title: Geniura — Recruitment and skills development
Metadata.description: Moroccan platform for recruitment and skills development: job offers, free applications, pre-selection services and explained matching.

Footer.tagline: A Moroccan platform with international ambition for recruitment and skills.
Footer.promise: Applying is always free. Your profile is only visible to the companies you apply to.
Footer.ctaTitle: Start with a job that suits you.
Footer.ctaBody: Anyone can browse without an account, and applying is always free.

Home.subtitle: Salary, requirements and closing date visible before you apply. Then the real status of your application, at every step.

preview.label: Example of an application being followed

free.title: Applying is always free
free.body: You will never be asked to pay to browse or apply.

latest.title: Latest jobs
latest.subtitle: Every card shows the salary status, even when the company does not disclose it.

steps.title: You always know where your application stands.

apply.body: Before sending, you see exactly what the company will receive from your profile.

follow.title: Follow the real status
follow.body: Every step comes from an action by the company, and the final decision is made by a person, not a machine.

profileFirst.promise: Let your experience open up new opportunities.
profileFirst.description: Build a structured professional profile, review your experience and skills, and explore job offers with ease.

profileFirst.browseBody: Explore published jobs without creating an account.

profileFirst.exploreBody: Browse jobs and apply when you choose.
profileFirst.employerBody: Discover the employer space and solutions suited to your needs.
profileFirst.trust: Free applications · Private profile by default · Human decisions

Employers.metaDescription: Post your jobs and manage your applications, or entrust pre-selection and assessment to the Geniura team.
Employers.subtitle: Post your job and manage applications yourself, or let the Geniura team help you pre-select and assess. Two separate paths, each with clear rules.
Employers.status: The employer space is being prepared. Create your account now and choose “representing a company” to be ready when it opens.

preview.label: Example of application management
preview.note: Every piece of information shows its source: declared, extracted or verified.

Employers.pathsTitle: Two paths, each with its purpose
Employers.pathsSubtitle: Posting a job and ordering a recruitment service are two different things.

publish.title: Run your recruitment yourself.
publish.body: For companies that want to receive and process applications directly.

items.one: A short posting flow: title and city, tasks and requirements, then preview and submit
items.two: A searchable, filterable applications table, without exposing anyone who has not applied
items.three: Statuses, interviews and messages in one place
items.four: Job review when needed, and a closing date visible to job seekers

service.title: Let us handle pre-selection.
service.body: For companies that want professional support to select and assess candidates.

items.one: You specify the number of positions, skills, conditions, location and scope
items.two: A clear service proposal, and your approval before any work starts
items.three: Pre-selection and assessment by the Geniura team, with limited access rights
items.four: A shortlist you can consult with controlled access

verified.title: Verified company
verified.body: We verify the company’s identity with supporting documents. Verification does not guarantee every detail of a job.

privacy.title: Candidate privacy
privacy.body: No bulk CV downloads, and no company can see another company’s files or decisions.

human.title: Human decisions
human.body: Matching explains its reasons and never rejects a candidate automatically.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.body: Owner, admin, recruiter, assessor: each member only accesses what their task requires.

account.title: Create your account
account.body: Registration is free. Choose “representing a company”.

verify.title: Get your company verified
verify.body: When the space opens, you submit the company’s documents for an internal review.

publish.title: Post or request
publish.body: Post your first job yourself, or describe your need to the recruitment service.

Skills.metaDescription: Optional upskilling suggestions tied to the requirements of a specific job, with no purchase required and no promise of a job.
Skills.subtitle: We compare the requirements of a specific job with your profile, explain what matches and what is missing, then suggest optional learning paths. No purchase required, no promise of a job.
Skills.status: This service is being prepared and is not open yet.

preview.label: Example of a profile compared with a job
preview.optional: Optional — you can apply right now

Skills.stepsTitle: From the job to the skill

choose.title: You choose a job
choose.body: Suggestions start from the requirements of a real job, never from a general judgement about you.

compare.title: We compare and explain
compare.body: We separate what you declared, what was extracted from your CV and what is verified, and show what is missing.

decide.title: You decide
decide.body: Apply now, or train first. The choice is always yours.

Skills.principlesTitle: Rules we do not compromise on

optional.title: Always optional
optional.body: No course purchase is ever required to send an application.

job.title: Tied to a job
job.body: The gap is measured against a specific job’s requirements, not a person’s worth.

noPromise.title: No false promises
noPromise.body: Training does not guarantee a job, and we will never say otherwise.

source.title: Clear source
source.body: Every skill shows its source, and extracted data never becomes “verified” on its own.

Skills.partnersBody: We are selecting assessment and training partners linked to labour-market needs. No partner will have access to the candidate database.

partialDate.invalid: Enter a valid date at the selected precision.
partialDate.rangeInvalid: The end date precedes the start date.
partialDate.firstDayUnsupported: The first day of a month cannot yet be saved as an exact day. Choose month precision or correct the date.

identity.summaryHint: A few sentences on what you do well and what you are looking for. Do not include health or family information.

private.line: Nobody sees it. You choose when to send it.
private.long: It appears nowhere. Only organizations you apply to see it, limited to what the preview shows.

applications_only.line: Only organizations you applied to can see it.
applications_only.long: Visible only to organizations you applied to, as shown in each application preview. No discovery.

discoverable.line: The Geniura team sees a card without your name.
discoverable.long: Geniura's recruitment team sees a card with no name or email: your city and the skills relevant to an opportunity. If they see a match, you get a sharing request and you decide.

visibility.paused: Discovery is paused because you chose "Not looking right now".

CandidateStart.title: Let’s start your professional profile
CandidateStart.subtitle: Your CV is a starting point. You review and confirm your information.
CandidateStart.description: Add your CV to extract its information, then review it before saving. You can also start without a CV.
CandidateStart.uploadBody: We extract the available information; you decide what to add to your profile.
CandidateStart.authBody: Sign in if you have an account, or create one to get started. We will return you to your chosen step.
CandidateStart.authNote: In the current version, upload and extraction start after sign-in. No file has been uploaded at this step.
CandidateStart.reviewPromise: After upload and scanning, review the extracted information before confirming it. Nothing is added to your profile automatically.
CandidateStart.manualTitle: Create your profile without a CV
CandidateStart.manualBody: Enter your details, experience, education and skills directly. You can add a CV later.
CandidateStart.privacy: Your profile is private by default. Your CV and contact details are not shared with an employer without appropriate permission.
CandidateStart.reviewTitle: Information is waiting for your review
CandidateStart.reviewBody: You can continue reviewing your previous CV before adding a new file.

GuestCv.title: Upload your CV
GuestCv.privacy: We will check the file and suggest its information. Your private draft expires after 24 hours and you can delete it at any time.
GuestCv.limits: PDF or DOCX, up to 5 MB.
GuestCv.processing: Checking your CV and extracting information…
GuestCv.failed: Processing failed. Delete this draft and try another file, or continue manually.
GuestCv.suggestions: These are suggestions and may need corrections. You will review professional information before accepting it. This name is only used for this greeting; correct it during registration.
GuestCv.name: Suggested name
GuestCv.claim: Link CV to my account and review
GuestCv.existing: Email confirmed. You have an account; sign in to continue.
GuestCv.newAccount: Email confirmed. Create an account to keep and review your draft.
GuestCv.sameEmail: Confirm the same email you use for your account to link this draft.
GuestCv.proofReason: Confirm your email so we can guide you to sign in or register. The extracted phone number does not prove identity.
GuestCv.sent: The code is valid for 10 minutes. Wait one minute before requesting another code.
GuestCv.changeEmail: Change email or request another code
